critical_incident.title: Vacation guardrail pause defeated by health_monitor — LIVE trade opened during 'paused' state
timeline: 01:40:14 vacation_guardrail pauses: 7d WR 34.4% < 35.0% (195T). Stops pipeline+watchdog+guardrail timers, sets kill JSON false, writes vacation_pause.json
01:48:25 health_monitor LLM agent sees pipeline timer dead, classifies as crash, AUTO-FIXES: systemctl start hermes-pipeline.timer
01:49:20 pipeline resumes. decider runs LIVE (is_live_trading_enabled only reads constant=True; JSON/marker ignored)
02:29:58 LIVE BTC SHORT ai-trader-manual opens ($11.10, lev5, paper=False, conf 70)
root_cause_chain: 1. is_live_trading_enabled() ignored pause marker — JSON deliberately removed (ghost-trades history) but marker never added
2. health_monitor prompt mandated 'restart any inactive timer' with no vacation-pause exception
3. Guardrail stopped its own timer on pause — no auto-resume path (design gap)
4. WR_7D_PAUSE criterion fires on WR alone — false-positive machine during fix-aging window
fixes_landed: vacation_guardrail: WR pause requires pnl_7d < -2.00; auto-resume WR>=37% or pnl_7d>=0; timer stays armed
health_monitor_prompt: pause marker overrides restart mandate for pipeline/watchdog
